title: Field guides for domain model portfolio prioritization
creator: Priya Desai
description: Create a concise, operational "field guide" that product, solutions, and procurement teams can use to prioritize which external/open models to onboard or recommend as fallbacks. The guide should combine market research signals (licensing, vendor stability, regional availability), runtime compatibility heuristics (quantization tolerance, memory footprint, kernel affinity), and customer-facing metrics (latency sensitivity, cost-per-token, model quality on representative prompt sets). Deliverables: 1) a scored rubric (CSV + human-readable cheat sheet) for quick filtering, 2) an automation spec for signal ingestion (sources, freshness, weighting), 3) sample eval prompt sets and pass/fail thresholds for domain pockets, and 4) a handoff checklist for sales/solutions to request procurement or dedicated capacity. Aim to reduce time-to-decision for model provisioning from weeks to days while surfacing procurement risk and operational cost implications.
acceptance_criteria: Rubric spreadsheet with >=12 signals and weighted scoring exported to CSV
Automation spec (raw signals, update cadence, transformation steps) reviewed by Eng
Three domain prompt suites (support, legal, finance) with baseline pass/fail thresholds
Dashboard filter mock in Confluence linking model score to latency/cost buckets
Handoff checklist validated with Solutions and Procurement and added to playbook
